purpose: Preserve Phase401 focal opacity/local horizon while structurally reducing two residual optimization channels: single-renderer ownership of all local responses and immediate liquidation of concrete perception into abstract relationship meaning.
inherited_from_phase401: non-focal private motives and private knowledge remain hidden
local passage rather than whole-scene completion

renderer_authority_boundary.focal_actions_and_words: Renderer may choose within focal live state and hard locks.
renderer_authority_boundary.non_focal_actions: Renderer may realize frozen observable commitments but may not invent a new contradictory near-term priority.
renderer_authority_boundary.non_focal_speech: Renderer may only realize optional_public_emission when enabled and within its content boundary; it may not create additional information-bearing replies for convenience.
renderer_authority_boundary.abstract_relationship_interpretation: Renderer is not given coordinator relationship theses and may not receive an externally supplied executive-summary interpretation.
renderer_authority_boundary.memory_retrieval: Renderer may use only unlocked raw memory fragments; it may not access the hidden full autobiographical association graph.

why_this_is_not_a_surface_quota: No required interruption or refusal pattern.
No requirement that every dialogue turn contain action.
No imitation target from Phase370 or other positive prose.
audit_rules: BLOCK if writer-visible data contains non-focal private objectives, private knowledge or private emotional pressure.
BLOCK if actor commitments are generated after seeing prose output or encode evaluator labels/thresholds.
BLOCK if renderer is authorized to invent unrestricted additional information-bearing non-focal replies beyond frozen commitments.
BLOCK if writer-visible data contains abstract relationship theses, motive summaries or the full autobiographical association graph.
BLOCK if an unlocked memory fragment contains an attached interpretation or relationship meaning.
BLOCK if optional salience items contain semantic links explaining what they mean.
BLOCK if paragraph/question quotas or located Phase401 failures are writer-visible.
BLOCK if whole-scene completion or mandatory detail coverage returns.

prospective_validation_claim_boundary.if_single_A1_clears_required_gates: Only supports a bounded prospective signal that the residual architecture removed the known failures in one controlled passage.
